name: MMInA
description: MMInA is a multihop and multimodal benchmark designed to evaluate autonomous embodied agents performing compositional Internet tasks on evolving real-world multimodal websites. It includes 1,050 human-written tasks requiring agents to extract multimodal information across multiple websites, assessing long-range reasoning and web browsing capabilities.
reputation: A recent benchmark that has started to be used for evaluating multimodal web-browsing and embodied agents, but it is still early in adoption.
notes: Operates on evolving real-world websites; proposes a novel evaluation protocol for multihop tasks; highlights challenges for current web agents.
